business_scope.primary_industry_name: Public Commercial Web Scraping and Proxy API Gateways

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law foundation with residual French civil law influences; offshore company law modeled on Caribbean common-law international company acts)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2014 and 2017, including the beneficial ownership record-keeping requirements; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (No. 16 of 2017, as amended) and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (Registered Agents) Regulations; VFSC AML/CFT Compliance Guidelines for Registered Agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate Beneficial Owner identity KYC pack (notarized copy of passport or government-issued national ID)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport office or identity authority of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a Convention member; otherwise Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for each UBO, director, and signatory (utility bill or recent bank statement, not older than 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed public utility or bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized true-copy certification, with Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization if expressly requested by the Vanuatu registered agent or VFSC

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Registry Extract of each corporate shareholder or ultimate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent authority of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization via the Vanuatu diplomatic mission in the issuing jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter (bank, attorney, or certified accountant) confirming the commercial background of the incorporators and beneficiaries
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank, law firm, or recognized public accounting firm in the client's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization when addressed to a Vanuatu government body; otherwise notarized certification acceptable for registered-agent internal CDD

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Consent of the VFSC-licensed registered agent and registered-office address confirmation letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not applicable (Vanuatu domestic corporate document); if required for foreign filing, notarization and apostille by Vanuatu Government Notary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory onboarding screening, prior to incorporation, of all proposed UBOs, directors, officers, shareholders, and authorized signatories against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List; (iii) the UK HM Treasury Consolidated List; (iv) the EU Consolidated Sanctions List; (v) the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit watch list and domestic adverse-information databases; and (vi) commercial global-screening databases (e.g., Dow Jones/World-Check) containing PEP, adverse media, and money-laundering risk indicators. Foreign and domestic Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), their family members, and close associates trigger automatic Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) requiring senior management approval of the registered agent. Sanctions hits are reported to the Vanuatu FIU without any client notification where required by law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies and International Companies Registry e-Services Portal (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory company names may be expressed in English, French, or Bislama but must be written in the Roman/Latin alphabet. Non-Roman scripts are not accepted; any foreign-script name must be transliterated into Latin characters using a standard romanization method. The corporate suffix 'Limited' (or 'Ltd.') is mandatory for International Company names. Diacritical marks in French/Bislama names are permissible in Latin script.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon formal rejection, the applicant (through its licensed registered agent) may file a Notice of Reconsideration/Appeal with the VFSC Registry within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The submission must include a cover letter stating the grounds for appeal, the original name-search report, and the applicable appeal fee of VUV 10,000 (approx. USD 75). VFSC is expected to respond within 15 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may either submit a fresh name clearance application avoiding the identified prohibited/sensitive tokens or apply for a numbered International Company name assigned by VFSC. A further judicial review remedy exists before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the constitutional judicial-review procedure, but alternative administrative resubmission is the commercially recommended path.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Standalone virtual office is not permissible; the International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the address of its VFSC-licensed registered agent. The agent may facilitate virtual business operations, but a real street address and active registered agent presence are mandatory; a P.O. Box cannot be used as the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for a non-financial, non-licensed data-pipeline entity; approximate annual risk of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered office is 5-10%. However, the registered agent's office carries a higher inspection probability under VFSC AML/CFT supervision, and direct inspection of a client's claimed operational premises may occur if sanctions/PEP screening flags or adverse information emerge.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), Part II (ss.4–14) and ss.18–25 (registered office, directors, secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and Trust Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 'Application for Registration of an International Company', together with subscriber-signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account requirement. Shares may be issued at such consideration as the subscribers/directors determine, including nil-paid or otherwise credited as fully paid under s.7 of the Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby ratify the registration of the company as an International Company under the Laws of Vanuatu and adopt the proposed corporate name as set out in the Certificate of Incorporation. RESOLVED FURTHER, that each subscriber takes the number of shares set opposite their name in the subscription list, and the same be allotted on the terms provided in the Memorandum and Articles. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the registered agent are formally approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the persons named in the annexure are appointed as the initial director, company secretary, and resident agent, each authorised to execute documents and open bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and corporate name reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry, Port Vila, or VFSC Online Services portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request specifying up to three proposed names in order of preference. The Registry checks the proposed name against the international companies register and prohibited names list. If available, the name is reserved for five business days; no notarization is required unless the name includes a sensitive expression.
required_dossiers: List of up to three proposed names in priority order
Copy of passport or corporate identification of each subscriber (where VFSC requests it)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for conflict or prohibited words, resubmit with a revised name set. If VFSC fails to decide within the SLA, escalate to the Registry Manager for priority consideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, execution, and filing of incorporation application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Company Registry, filed through a licensed registered agent or directly via VFSC Online Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, execute the subscriber declaration and statement of compliance, then submit Form 1 together with the paid fee. The subscribers and initial director/signature must be notarized if the application is made physically; online submissions require digital consent.
required_dossiers: Form 1 Application for Registration of an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association, executed by subscribers
Statement of compliance signed by the registered agent or a founding director
Consent of each proposed director and the secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries particulars or finds a defective document, the applicant may file an administrative correction within 14 days. Failure to respond leads to automatic refusal without prejudice to a fresh filing and refund of the unapplied portion of the filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of state filing and registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Treasury Office and Registrar’s cashier, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official state filing fee and first-year VFSC annual fee in Vatu or US Dollars by bank transfer, direct deposit, card, or in-cash at the VFSC cashier. Reference the proposed company name or applicant reference on every remittance.
required_dossiers: Proforma fee invoice issued by VFSC
Bank payment receipt or cashier receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Underpayments are reconciled within five business days; overpayments are set off against the first annual fee or refunded on written request. If payment is delayed, certificate issuance is suspended until cleared funds are confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and registration confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Company Registry / Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After verifying compliance and receipt of fees, the Registrar files the incorporation notice, assigns a registration number and date of incorporation, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation together with a certified copy of the registered office address and any certificate requested. The registered agent collects the documents.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certificate details contain typographical errors, the applicant returns the certificate with a cover letter and the Registrar rectifies under s.20 of the Act within three business days. If no certificate is issued despite paid fees, provide remittance proof for re-certification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation corporate governance and statutory records setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial directors, company secretary, and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass a unanimous written resolution adopting the pro-forma board resolution. Appoint the initial director and secretary, authorize the registered office, issue subscribed share certificates, and open a corporate bank account if intended. Ensure the register of directors and registered person records are lodged at the registered office in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Minutes of first board meeting or unanimous written resolution
Share certificate stubs and subscription list
Register of directors, secretary, and shareholders
Registered office address confirmation from agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If governance records are challenged, the directors may ratify by retroactive unanimous written consent. Changes in director or secretary must be notified to VFSC on the prescribed form within 14 days; late filing incurs a modest penalty but is correctable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – International Companies that operate exclusively offshore in data-processing and API services are not subject to Vanuatu's Industrial Licenses Act; only International Companies Act registration applies. If physical office space is later leased, the Urban Development and Leases Act may regulate premises but no industrial license arises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – the Certificate of Incorporation serves as the legal capacity instrument; a public commercial web scraping and API gateway business does not require a separate operating license as it involves no goods, manufacturing, or 'prescribed activity' under VFSC licensing regulations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / None – the proposed activity is a digital data pipeline and proxy API gateway with no physical construction, no land use, and no emission-generating infrastructure. It is not listed in Schedule 2 of Vanuatu's Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations, and no EIA report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the core cloud/API activity. If a local office is later occupied, municipal wastewater limits for domestic effluent, generator exhaust emission limits under the Mines and Minerals Department air quality thresholds, and electronic waste disposal obligations under the Waste Management Regulations would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable while the company maintains only a statutory registered office and no local staff or physical premises. If a Vanuatu office is subsequently established, the lessee/employer must obtain a fire safety occupancy certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service, a structural load inspection certificate for the building, and occupational safety registration under the Health and Safety at Work Act – no special civil defense permit is required for an API service office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Vanuatu; official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, or annual corporate tax; therefore an International Company (IC) obtains no income-tax TIN at incorporation. The sole statutory indirect-tax identifier is the VAT registration number issued by DCIR under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 246]. Compulsory registration arises only if the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu and annual taxable turnover reaches VUV 5,000,000; an offshore IC selling data/API services exclusively to non-residents remains outside the VAT net and does not register. Procedure: file VAT-01 registration form, certificate of incorporation issued by Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), certified passport copies of directors and beneficial owners, proof of registered agent address in Vanuatu, and a statutory declaration confirming offshore status under s.33 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; DCIR issues the VAT number within 5–10 business days. Imported services consumed in Vanuatu are reverse-charged by the local recipient (no non-resident supplier registration required).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — an IC certified under s.133 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] enjoys absolute exemption from Vanuatu income tax, VAT, stamp duty, customs duties, and all transaction-based taxes for 20 years from incorporation, renewable; all foreign-source API/data revenue is territorially exempt; the IC may not carry on domestic trade with Vanuatu residents without VFSC written consent, preserving zero domestic fiscal nexus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch mechanism exists in Vanuatu. The operative statutory election is the renewable 20-year tax-exemption certificate issued ex officio by the VFSC at incorporation. The IC may irrevocably elect to convert to a domestic company (thereby becoming VAT-registrable and subject to domestic law) only with VFSC approval; absent such approval no further classification election is available or required.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover (approx. USD 42,000) for goods and services supplied in Vanuatu; imported services used in Vanuatu are reverse-charged by the local recipient without supplier registration; cross-border data/API services supplied to non-residents do not count toward the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — Vanuatu operates no mandatory e-invoicing regime, no real-time fiscal clearance platform, no government API clearance gateway, and no digital fiscal stamping. DCIR accepts self-issued paper or PDF tax invoices containing the statutory content (seller name, address and VAT number; buyer name and address; invoice number and date; description; quantity; unit price; VAT rate 0% or 12.5%; VAT amount; total); retained records must substantiate any zero-rating claim.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to (i) goods physically exported from Vanuatu and (ii) services supplied to a non-resident person where the services relate to movable or offshore property located outside Vanuatu or are wholly consumed outside Vanuatu (VAT Act [Cap 246] s.6 and Schedule 3). A commercial web-scraping/proxy API subscription sold to non-resident clients qualifies as an export of services invoiced at 0%, provided supporting evidence demonstrates overseas consumption: non-resident contractual counterparty, foreign billing address, delivery through non-VU servers/IP nodes, and absence of domestic usage. No VAT refund is needed because no output VAT is charged on qualifying exports; input VAT incurred by the exempt IC is not creditable but is immaterial given the IC's zero domestic input exposure. Vanuatu maintains no exchange controls; the 180-day treasury convention for inward remittance is applied as a banking-standard evidentiary norm rather than a statutory repatriation deadline.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: VU Customs Export Declaration (electronic lodgement via Vanuatu National Single Window)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (for physical-goods exports; not applicable to pure API/data services)
Signed contract/service order with non-resident counterparty (for data/API services)
Delivery and consumption evidence: server/IP geolocation reports, API call logs, and client certification of offshore use
Bank Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT receipt evidencing foreign-currency settlement (administrative FX record)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR audit window is 3 years, extended to 6 years in cases of fraud or wilful evasion (VAT Act [Cap 246] s.30). Wrongful zero-rating or VAT evasion attracts a civil penalty of 200% of the tax evaded plus interest at 12.5% per annum, and individuals are liable on conviction to imprisonment of up to 5 years; any incorrectly paid refund is clawed back immediately with interest. For ICs, breach of s.33 of the International Companies Act (domestic trading without VFSC consent) voids the s.133 tax exemption retrospectively from the date of breach, exposing the entity to 12.5% VAT on all domestic taxable supplies plus a civil penalty of up to VUV 500,000; renewal of the 20-year exemption certificate is conditioned on a clean compliance review.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting jointly in an oversight capacity with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for International Company licensing, AML/CFT supervision, and financial-sector fit-and-proper controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions. Vanuatu maintains no general exchange-control regime applicable to International Companies, and there is no prior RBV approval requirement for equity injections, dividend remittances, service fees, or liquidation proceeds. Non-resident-owned ICs may hold multi-currency accounts with resident licensed banks and freely remit funds abroad, subject only to bank-level KYC/AML due diligence and record retention. Profit repatriation is unrestricted and is not subject to any withholding tax under Vanuatu law.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender regime exists under the Reserve Bank Act or the International Companies Act. There is no mandatory conversion ratio, no forced repatriation period, and no requirement to sell foreign currency proceeds to an RBV-designated dealer. The only compliance obligations are transactional record keeping, reasonable invoice/contract retention, and accurate disclosure to the resident receiving bank for AML and sanctions screening purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: International Company Multi-Currency Operational and Settlement Account (USD/VUV/foreign currency)
Corporate Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account (USD/VUV)
Domestic Corporate Operational Account (suitable for local-payable and VUV settlement; limited offshore treasury functionality)
Corporate Current Account and Multi-Currency Foreign-Exchange Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Risk but legally permissible. Vanuatu has no domestic FinTech or EMI licensing regime; therefore cross-border digital EMI account providers may onboard the Vanuatu IC solely as a non-resident corporate client. Such providers must hold a valid e-money or payment-institution license in a recognized FATF jurisdiction, must apply full CDD, and must not be used for VUV clearing. An EMI account can function as a receiving rail for Stripe gateway settlements and as a conversion gateway for USDC, but the principal treasury and counterparty relationship should remain with a RBV-licensed tier-1 bank to satisfy substance and banking-risk requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally accepted. Directors are not statutorily required to travel to Vanuatu; the bank will accept apostilled incorporation documents, certified passports, proof of residential address, board resolutions, and a video/teleconference identity verification. Enhanced due diligence may require a physical meeting or a face-to-face interview before a notary for complex ownership structures, highly exposed jurisdictions, or PEP signatories. Banks also retain discretion to require one in-person relationship meeting for the beneficial owner where aggregate exposure exceeds institutional thresholds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee and offshore-holding ownership chain without a transparent economic owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Certificate of Incumbency; notarized declaration of trust if nominee shares exist; full legal-ownership waterfall from IC to ultimate natural-person beneficial owner; VFSC registered-agent compliance letter; annual compliance certificate and passport copies of all beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume recurring payments from web-scraping and proxy API activity, creating potential data-privacy and third-party-rights exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial contracts with downstream customers; lawful-access evidence including API terms, robots.txt compliance or licensing; data-processing and data-protection policies; contractual warranties covering personal-data handling; incident-response and takedown procedures; evidence that the IC does not access protected or sanctioned content.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Stablecoin or USDC treasury flows and rapid conversion to fiat without an identifiable counterparty
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: List of approved VASP/wallet counterparties; blockchain-address attribution and travel-rule compliance records; source-of-funds statements for each conversion event; transaction-monitoring policies; contractual restrictions against mixer/high-risk wallet exposure; board-approved cryptocurrency risk and AML policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and adverse-media exposure of data-center, bandwidth, or payment-intermediary counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time sanctions screening logs against UN, EU, OFAC, and RBV lists; IP-geolocation and denial-of-service controls; counterparty due-diligence questionnaires; commercial sub-processor registers; negative-media screening reports; contractual requirement for counterparties to maintain equivalent sanctions compliance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital is routed by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the shareholder's bank to the IC's designated multi-currency account, with the ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose code 'EQUI' and a beneficiary reference stating 'Share Capital Contribution'. The file must include a board capital-call resolution, subscription schedule, source-of-wealth questionnaire, certified ownership chain, and, where requested, the shareholder's bank statement. No RBV exchange-control approval is required. The registered agent must record contributed capital in the IC register and file the relevant annual return with VFSC. Where the parent entity is in a CFC/BEPS-sensitive jurisdiction, substance documentation in Vanuatu should be retained to support treasury autonomy.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement of outbound trade and operating disbursements is executed through SWIFT MT103 for vendor/operator transfers, MT202 for bank-to-bank reimbursement where intermediary banks are used, and MT700 for commercial letters of credit where hardware, bandwidth, or infrastructure procurement requires document-backed payment security. Supporting documents include commercial invoices, service-level agreements, delivery receipts, and downstream customer licenses. For USDC-based payment rails, disbursement is made as a blockchain transfer from a licensed VASP wallet to the counterparty's verified wallet, with an omnibus fiat reconciliation through the tier-1 bank or EMI account and a full audit trail of conversion rates and wallet addresses.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards of up to 12 months between VUV, USD, EUR, and AUD with an RBV-licensed commercial bank or an approved overseas dealer under the IC's treasury policy
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for VUV or regional Pacific currency exposures settled in USD, where physical delivery is impractical
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between USD and EUR for medium-term treasury liabilities and capital-structure hedging
Long-dated FX options purchased on a premium-payment basis for downside protection on uncertain API-revenue or bandwidth-procurement cash flows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Renewal Fee for International Company (no statutory annual return is required for Vanuatu International Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of International Companies, collected via the licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each anniversary of incorporation; VFSC has no fixed calendar-year deadline; the registered agent issues the renewal invoice approximately 60 days before the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the fee for each month or part of a month of delay; non-payment beyond 3 months after the anniversary permits VFSC to administratively strike off the company; restoration requires settlement of all arrears, penalties, and a restoration application fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation Declaration (private UBO register update; no public annual UBO filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent (maintains the statutory beneficial-ownership register at the registered office; available for VFSC inspection on demand)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the incorporation anniversary together with fee renewal; any direct or indirect shareholding transfer, change in voting control, or change in senior managing official must be notified to the registered agent within 14 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or update the beneficial-ownership register is an offence under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; VFSC may impose statutory fines and daily default penalties, and the registered agent may resign, exposing the company to strike-off if a replacement agent is not appointed within the statutory window

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Compliance Certificate and Statutory Register Audit Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent (certification retained at the registered office; VFSC may conduct unscheduled register inspections)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the incorporation anniversary, at the same time as the government fee renewal; VFSC audits may occur at any time without notice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Misrepresentation or failure to keep the registered office registers current is a default offence under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; VFSC may order rectification, impose fines, and in aggravated cases initiate administrative strike-off or refer the matter for director disqualification

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act [CAP 222], irrespective of revenue, assets, or number of shareholders. An audit is not filed with VFSC or any tax authority; an audit may become a contractual requirement imposed by a bank, investor, or payment processor (e.g., Stripe) but never a VFSC statutory condition. The company's business scope (web scraping and proxy API gateways) is not a Vanuatu economic substance 'relevant activity', so no economic substance return or substance audit applies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No domestic GAAP is prescribed for International Companies. If financial statements are prepared for lender, investor, or payment-processor due diligence, they are typically prepared under IFRS as adopted by the directors, with IFRS 15 applied to API subscription revenue and IFRS 9 (or IAS 38 for crypto-assets) applied to USDC and stablecoin payment rails. Accounts must be kept at the registered office or elsewhere as the directors determine and must not be filed with VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and VFSC AML/CFT rules, the registered agent must collect and maintain a private beneficial-ownership register at the registered office; there is no public UBO filing with VFSC. Each incorporation anniversary, every director and shareholder must complete a written confirmation identifying every individual holding 25% or more of shares, 25% or more voting rights, or control through other means; any share transfer or change in control must be reported to the registered agent within 14 days so that the register of members and the UBO register are updated simultaneously.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - 1,000 for a standard licensed registered agent package including registered office, registered agent service, corporate secretarial work, and annual UBO compliance; USD 1,200 - 2,500 if nominee director or nominee shareholder services are added
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 because no statutory audit is required; voluntary certified audit or financial statement compilation for a low-volume web-scraping API company is typically USD 3,000 - 8,500 depending on transaction volume and crypto-asset balances

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no national corporate income tax. An International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1993 is classified as a Tax-Exempt Zone entity: all offshore-source income, dividends, interest, royalties, and capital gains are statutorily exempt from Vanuatu income tax, and no GST/VAT (12.5% standard rate) applies to exported data services or supplies made to non-residents. The effective tax rate on globally sourced commerce-scraping and API-gateway revenue is therefore 0%, subject only to the annual VFSC government fee in lieu of taxation and the condition that the IC does not trade with Vanuatu residents. A 12.5% VAT/GST applies to domestic supplies once annual taxable turnover exceeds the statutory registration threshold of VT 10 million, but B2B exported web-scraping/proxy API subscriptions remain zero-rated and fall outside the IC's effective cost base.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu International Company Annual Return (VFSC Form IC-AR) and VFSC Annual Government Fee, lodged digitally through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Services online portal by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return is due within 3 months after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual government refresher fee is payable on or before each anniversary date. No corporate income tax return is filed because no income tax is levied on International Companies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, VFSC International Company registration number, date of incorporation, and registered office address in Port Vila.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must ensure the legal name matches the constitutional documents supplied to the registered agent; the VFSC does not require any Vanuatu tax identifier because the IC is tax-exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identity of the licensed Vanuatu registered agent, the agent's client due-diligence statement, and confirmation that the statutory registered office is maintained in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC must appoint and continuously retain a Vanuatu-licensed registered agent; all filings are channelled exclusively through the agent, and no physical attendance in Vanuatu is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C — Directors and Corporate Secretary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, nationality, usual residential address, passport number, and date of appointment of each director and the corporate secretary, with executed consent forms attached.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be wholly non-resident persons or nominee corporate directors; each must be disclosed to VFSC with a signed consent, and no work permit is required for offshore directorship.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D — Shareholding and Beneficial Ownership Register
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of members showing classes of shares, issued and paid-up capital, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) particulars cross-checked against the AML/CFT client file.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident UBOs must supply passport, proof of address, and source-of-funds evidence for the agent's customer due diligence file; bearer shares and anonymous holdings are fatal red flags and are functionally unavailable for a compliant IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section E — Authorised Capital and Fee Tier
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised share capital amount in VT or USD, which determines the annual government fee tier, plus a statement of paid-up capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for an IC; a USD-denominated capital table is permitted, and stamp duty on issued capital is 0% for the IC class.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC carries any ESR relevant activity (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, IP holding, distribution and service centre) and, if yes, an attached schedule of employees, premises, expenditure, and board management/control in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure commerce-scraping/proxy API vehicle normally declares 'no relevant activity'; if the IC books intellectual-property, head-office, or distribution-centre revenue, non-resident directors should expect an ESR review and must be able to evidence genuine Vanuatu substance rather than merely filing a negative declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgment of the IC Annual Return triggers a VFSC penalty of VT 100,000 per commenced month, plus compounded interest on unpaid annual fees; continued default removes the IC's Good Standing status, and after 12 months VFSC may administratively strike the company off the register without further notice. Reinstatement after strike-off requires a restoration application with all arrears, penalties, and an additional restoration filing fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Certificate of Good Standing issued via the registered agent from the VFSC corporate registry database.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: On demand; not a periodic statutory filing
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Issued within 3-7 business days of application; valid only as evidence of due registration and payment of annual fees up to the date of issue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and VFSC registration number of the International Company, including any former names.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Banks, Stripe, and USDC stablecoin counterparties require the certificate to match the entity schedule and merchant account title exactly; any mismatch can freeze payment rails.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Stated commercial purpose: payment-processor onboarding, counterparty due diligence, ISIC 6201/NAICS 518210 classification confirmation, or legal-opinion support.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A VFSC Certificate of Good Standing does not evidence Vanuatu tax residency and cannot be represented as a tax-residence certificate to foreign revenue authorities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No statutory penalty applies, but the certificate is refused if the IC is in arrears of annual fees, which operates as an automatic commercial disqualifier for banking and payment-rail relationships.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders, whether settled in cash, stablecoin, or book-entry form.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive Double Tax Agreement (DTA) network and maintains only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs). Consequently, no DTA withholding-relief filing, Tax Residency Certificate (TRC), or advance tax clearance is available or required for outbound Vanuatu dividends. A shareholder seeking treaty shelter in its home jurisdiction should obtain a home-jurisdiction tax residence certificate; the Vanuatu side only supplies the VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and, where needed, a notarised board resolution declaring the dividend.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu withholding tax on outbound royalties and debt interest is 0%; because no comprehensive DTA network exists with commercially relevant counterparties, there is no separate reduced treaty rate. IP royalties and interest flowing into the IC remain exempt from Vanuatu income tax, but Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) scrutiny attaches if royalty or financing income is derived from connected group activity without verifiable Vanuatu substance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu's domestic law does not contain a transfer-pricing code, and no Local File or Master File documentation threshold exists under Vanuatu statutory instruments. The VFSC and the Financial Intelligence Unit nevertheless review cross-border related-party flows as part of ESR and AML examinations.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019 and the Economic Substance Regulations apply to International Companies carrying on a relevant activity: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, or holding-company and IP functions. A Vanuatu IC licensing a public web-scraping/proxy API must file an annual ESR return with VFSC declaring its activities; if classified as a distribution and service centre or headquarters, it must demonstrate in Vanuatu: (i) management and control exercised through duly recorded board meetings; (ii) adequate physical office premises; (iii) an adequate number of full-time employees proportionate to the API turnover; and (iv) minimum annual operating expenditure. A passively held offshore IP-owning IC must maintain 'adequate' staff and premises for its IP assets and cannot rely on a pure nominee structure to satisfy ESR.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Vanuatu IC while failing to register for the 12.5% VAT/GST where annual taxable turnover exceeds the statutory threshold or where services are rendered to Vanuatu residents; deliberately suppressing transaction records, issuing false invoices, or using USDC crypto settlement rails to conceal turnover from a partner jurisdiction under an active TIEA exchange request.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the VAT Act 1998, evasion of tax attracts a criminal fine of up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 years, plus recovery of the unpaid VAT, a late-payment penalty, and a daily surcharge. TIEA cooperation permits exchange of banking and beneficial-ownership records with foreign tax authorities, materially increasing cross-border detection risk.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court may hold directors personally liable for the unpaid VAT where the corporate form was used as a sham or where they knowingly made false declarations; on criminal conviction, directors face imprisonment, disqualification orders, and civil restitution orders up to the full evaded amount.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and ESR False Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC with no physical presence, no employees, and no board meetings in Vanuatu while booking data-subscription and IP-licence income from multiple jurisdictions; or filing a false 'no relevant activity' ESR declaration when the data-API business in substance constitutes a head-office or service-centre relevant activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may impose a civil penalty of VT 500,000 per offence plus VT 20,000 per day of continuing breach; severe or repeated failure to meet economic substance triggers a report to the Vanuatu revenue authority and to the OECD/EU Code of Conduct, loss of IC tax-exempt status, and administrative strike-off/dissolution with no statutory compensation to shareholders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign a knowingly false ESR declaration are criminally liable with fines up to VT 5,000,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years; the VFSC may also seek a court order requiring directors to disgorge profits gained by the shell structure and may petition for a travel ban or securities order freezing their departure from Vanuatu during the investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach, Money Laundering and UBO Concealment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting subscription payments from anonymous wallet addresses, running the scraping/API gateway without a documented AML/CFT risk assessment, failing to maintain a beneficial-ownership register, settling commission payments through layered crypto conversions, or processing Stripe card payments where a zero-effort onboarding flow allows identity spoofing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2006 (Cap 296), an individual convicted of money laundering faces a fine up to VT 100,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 25 years; the Financial Intelligence Unit may impose supervisory penalties, suspend the registered agent relationship, and freeze connected accounts; the VFSC may cancel the IC's registration and refer the matter for criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: AML offences attach to the natural-person controller as much as to the entity; directors are severally liable and face restraint orders, confiscation of proceeds, travel bans, extradition to treaty partner jurisdictions, and up to 25 years' imprisonment without the possibility of sheltering behind the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Advertising the Vanuatu IC as a holder of a 'regulatory licence', promising guaranteed anonymity or tax-free status in foreign markets, collecting API-contract prepayments while insolvent, or trading with intent to defraud creditors in circumstances where insolvent winding-up is likely.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Vanuatu Companies Act (Cap 191) fraudulent-trading provisions, applied by analogy to ICs under the International Companies Act 1993, render directors responsible for all debts contracted during the fraudulent period; the court may order civil restitution, disqualify directors for up to 5 years, and impose criminal fines up to VT 1,000,000 plus imprisonment up to 7 years for dishonest conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced automatically on a fraudulent-trading finding: directors become personally jointly and severally liable for the IC's liabilities, may be ordered to repay all amounts so obtained, and a departure-prohibition order may prevent them from leaving Vanuatu or partner-jurisdiction airports until restitution is made.
